text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to build ability has begun.
As for North Flight—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I saved a seat for you.
Please, take the one by the window!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's mine!
The floral pattern is so bright and cute, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, it's exceptionally practical too!
It's a long journey, so let's take it easy and relax♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
...♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because,
it's the summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"This is the first time I can truly participate properly.
Up until now, my health had been holding me back."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I know I still can't break past
my limits just yet. But...
choice_data_list: I can run with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm so happy...♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like we're departing.
I wonder what kind of training camp this will be—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
what lovely weather!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Under such a wonderful sun...
Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-saaan,
welcome!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you!
And with that, every participant from our class has arrived... perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, for the next item to check!
Flight-san, how are you feeling?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm doing great!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, perfect!
"Flight-san, are you doing well?" ...and done.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...How is Bakushin O-chan doing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight asked casually, but...
Sakura Bakushin O had sat out the entire
spring season to monitor the condition of her legs.
choice_data_list: (I'm sure it's a frustrating time for her, but—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I am bakushin-ing with utter vigor!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'm in top condition!
After all, I've been stockpiling plenty of Bakushin!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make a massive explosion... no, a massive Bakushin this fall!
—Armed with my secret weapon!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A secret weapon...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! In other words—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan.
It's a secret, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaaah, that's right!
That's a big no-no!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret, a secreeeet!!
Bakushiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wonder what kind of weapon
Bakushin O-chan has acquired...
choice_data_list: Gotta hone Flight's new weapon too!
Gotta hone Flight's new weapon too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"A medium-distance coordinate...
for the Shuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll put together a unique outfit that looks great on me, just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight is fired up and ready to go.
And so, our intense summer training camp began!
